column1: # Machine-readable RBAC matrix (application port). docs/security/RBAC_MATRIX.md mirrors every row.
# kind: ENDPOINT = a mapped /api/** handler (method + exact mapping pattern); SITE = a mapped handler outside
# /api/**; RESERVED = URL rule as a whole (its mapped routes have their own rows); FALLBACK = sample of an
# unmapped path. Status cells: HTTP status of a valid request

column2: OPEN = permitted by the URL rule (no handler to call).
